title: Cooling Tower & Water Tanks
description: Two RC cooling towers and their basins serving the direct and indirect water circuits of a water treatment plant (WTP) within a direct reduced iron (DRI) steel production facility.
scope: RC design, thermal gradient analysis, hydrostatic/hydrodynamic loading, pile foundation design.
keyFigures: Indirect tower: 75 m × 21 m × 4 m (height 16 m); direct tower: 15 m × 18 m × 4 m (height 12 m); concrete volume: ≈ 7,100 m³; reinforcement: 875 t.
deliverables: Concrete drawings: 50 A1 sheets; steelwork/stairs drawings: 12 A1 sheets; full calculation reports.
challenge: Crack width control under combined thermal and hydrostatic loading.

title: Multi-Purpose Sports Hall
client: Cultural and Sports Complex | FIE Co.
description: Multi-purpose recreational facility of 9,300 m² with a 3,000-seat capacity, designed to host competitions including futsal, volleyball, and basketball.
scope: Design of steel frames and connections alongside internal RC structures comprising changing rooms and café, as well as reinforced concrete spectator platforms and foundations.
keyFigures: Clear span: 50 m; footprint: 50 × 78 m; ridge height: 23 m; structural steel: 417 t; foundation concrete: 1,360 m³.
deliverables: Concrete drawings: 53 A1 sheets; steel structure drawings: 22 A1 sheets; full calculation reports.
myRole: Structural designer for the steel portion; design reviewer and approver for the concrete portion.
challenge: Selecting an appropriate structural system posed a significant challenge given the unit-price contract nature of the project and strict architectural constraints. Through evaluation of alternatives, a moment frame system was adopted, achieving approximately 20% cost optimization — an outcome that directly led to my appointment as Project Manager for the full contract scope.

title: Continuous Casting Machine — Area 1
description: RC structures for a billet CCM (Continuous Casting Machine), designed to Danieli equipment requirements.
scope: RC design for high-temperature thermal gradients on thick walls and cooling chamber slabs, with settlement limitations imposed by Danieli for slabs and foundations.
keyFigures: Wall thickness: up to 800 mm; concrete volume: ≈ 2,700 m³; reinforcement: 310 t; design temperature: up to 140 °C.
deliverables: Concrete drawings: 71 A1 sheets; full calculation reports.
challenge: The structure's complex geometry was dictated by equipment and process requirements. The design had to withstand extreme thermal conditions and heavy mechanical loads, including a 7,300 kN static ladle turret load.

title: Screen Building
description: Steel structure for the Screen Building in the 2.5 MTPY (million tonnes per year) iron ore pelletizing plant.
scope: Structure and foundation design of a screening building, accounting for dynamic equipment loads, with provision of support structures for screening machinery and inlet/outlet conveyor systems.
keyFigures: Dimensions: 27 m × 18 m × 25 m; structural steel: 414 t; foundation concrete: 1,450 m³; reinforcement: 165 t.
deliverables: Steelwork drawings: 60 A1 sheets; foundation drawings: 9 A1 sheets; full calculation reports.
challenge: Accommodating equipment supports, including screens and conveyors, within a constrained structural layout, and controlling beam deflections to limit screen vibration and ensure uninterrupted operational performance.

title: SAG Mill Feed
description: Conveyor trusses, self-supporting bridges, galleries and walkways for a SAG mill feed system.
scope: Structure and foundation design of conveyors and supporting towers.
keyFigures: Conveyor length: 105 m; longest span: 30 m; structural steel: 75 t.
deliverables: Steelwork drawings: 30 A1 sheets; foundation drawings: 11 A1 sheets; full calculation reports.
myRole: Structural designer and drafter; design reviewer and approver for self-supporting part.
challenge: Modeling complex curved geometry, controlling deflection and determining truss depth, and designing roller connections to adjacent structures.

title: Amphitheater
client: Cultural and Sports Complex | FIE Co.
description: Steel structure for an open-air amphitheater with a long-span curved roof.
scope: Structure and foundation design of amphitheater with long-span roof.
keyFigures: Dimensions: 50 m × 50 m × 15 m; roof span: 25 m; structural steel: 540 t; foundation concrete: 1,440 m³; reinforcement: 74 t.
deliverables: Steelwork drawings: 43 A1 sheets; foundation drawings: 15 A1 sheets; full calculation reports.
challenge: Modeling a long-span curved beam under significant live loading.

title: Residential Timber
description: Structural assessment and retrofit design for an existing wood-frame residential building.
scope: Identified load-bearing walls flagged by the architect for removal, provided beam and post solutions to maintain structural integrity, and designed new load paths in accordance with the National Building Code of Canada.
challenge: Distinguishing load-bearing walls from partition walls in an existing building with incomplete as-built documentation. Tracing the load path through multiple floor levels, sizing replacement beams under combined gravity loads, and selecting appropriate bearing conditions where new posts landed on existing framing.

title: Rotary Kiln & Cooler
client: Dolomite & Magnesite Sintering Plant | FIE Co.
description: Massive RC foundations for a rotary kiln and cooler at a dolomite and magnesite sintering plant.
keyFigures: Kiln length: 60 m; concrete: 1,000 m³; reinforcement: 120 t; thermal load: up to 90 °C.
deliverables: Concrete drawings: 20 A1 sheets; full calculation reports.
challenge: Ensuring sliding/overturning stability and controlling long-term settlement under combined thermal and dynamic kiln loads. Deep beam design criteria applied due to structural geometry.
